result.title: See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight
result.summary: Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME first trains a hindsight teacher with a hindsight attention mask, mismatched-candidate conditioning, and query-token alignment to limit excessive reliance on the candidate. It then freezes the teacher and distills its hindsight representation and similarity distribution into a standalone student embedder. At inference, the student independently encodes queries and candidates without candidate conditioning or the hindsight teacher. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and the agent and text tasks of MMEB-V3 demonstrate the effectiveness of HEME and show that it enables more efficient inference than explicit reasoning-driven methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究通用多模态嵌入：训练时让模型看到匹配候选这一「后见」上下文，通过带后见注意力掩码、错配候选条件和查询对齐的 teacher，把后见表示与相似度分布蒸馏给学生；推理时学生独立编码，不需候选条件或额外推理计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用特权上下文 teacher 加蒸馏、并以错配和掩码约束防止查询表示坍缩到候选嵌入的设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态被答案式捷径信息坍缩及训练监督分配提供可核查线索，但论文本身不研究视觉推理状态生成。
